title: Fake-DOM move: prompt-section-go pricing probe onto loadWorld
description:
Plan piece 3: the pricing probe.

Move `tests/unit/prompt-section-go.test.js` (30 tests, 15 reads of fake internals, a click shim, and LIN-4247's `replaceGoSlot` tests) onto `loadWorld` (`helpers/client-world.js`). Delete its `makeContainer`, `replaceSlot`/`replaceGoSlot` and `vm.createContext` copies.

* **Assertion map, as a table in the PR.** `_fullRenders` unchanged becomes node identity kept across a partial repaint (hold a node from before the press, then assert `===`). Where there is no node to hold, use a spy on the container's `innerHTML` setter. `_clickHandler` becomes `container.click(dataset)`. `_html` becomes `container.innerHTML`, or better, a `querySelector` on what is drawn. Each replacement must go red under the mutation it guards, for example a Go press that writes `container.innerHTML`, or a slot replaced through a full render.
* **Expected reds.** The old fake's null `querySelector` hid the question-card keep, focus restore and swipe-options paths. If the run-change panel repaints with a draft, expect `value is not modelled on <select>` (`fake-dom.js:313`). Record that as a fake artefact and stop that test there; it is not a client bug (review note 4).
* **Gate.** The PR says what this move cost (reds, replacements, lines) and whether the remaining prompt-section suites will cost the same. If this one suite took more than a session, say so on LIN-4255. The prompt-section family then stops here, and the two follow-on prompt-section subtasks are re-planned rather than carried on.

**Done when:** test names and counts are unchanged (empty diff pasted), `prompt-section-go.test.js` is off the census list, the assertion map has a mutation per row, and the findings list and gate statement are in the PR.

---

**Where the scope and design live.** Parent: LIN-4255. Read its description's **Implementation Plan** (the approved plan) and the Plan Review Verdict comment `98a20bc0-f43b-406c-bb64-8ce22860b08f`, which has notes for the builder. The parent's approved plan is where this piece starts. Follow it. Where the code shows the plan is wrong, change course and say so in a comment on LIN-4255.

* Session fit: fits one session
* Plan-review due: no. Covered by LIN-4255's approving plan-review (comment 98a20bc0-f43b-406c-bb64-8ce22860b08f, rev 1).
* Grounding commit: `b5391736` (LinearViewer origin/main; still HEAD when this breakdown was made on 2026-11-05).

**Rules for every move piece (from the plan):** test names and counts stay the same. Before and after, run `node --test --test-reporter=spec <file>` and paste the empty diff. Remove each moved file from `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` and from the `fake-dom.js` header's consumer list in the same PR. Delete both copies, the container and the `vm` sandbox. Never loosen an assertion that reads fake internals: map it to a real-DOM replacement and prove the replacement goes red under the mutation it guards. Every red is a finding, and the PR records it as fixed, filed or fake artefact. Serializer differences (`disabled=""`, escaping) are fixed in the test's regexes, never by relaxing the fake. Out of scope: the 7 `container.querySelector ? … : null` guards in `public/prompt-section.js`.

parent.title: The shared fake DOM becomes the one in fact: move the hand-written client test fakes onto it, with a census (LIN-4252 tidy-after)

comments.body:
LIN-4266 done (beat 5/5). PR: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2299 (base main, head eec8eb12b04b72cdf8a5a076af35ad54e66c78df, not merged).

CI on the head, all pass (run 42039197932): Unit tests, E2E shards 1/4 to 4/4, Secret scan (source), CI success.

The PR description has the per-row assertion map (R1 to R12, each with its real-DOM replacement and the measured mutation result), the empty before/after test-name diff (30 tests, same order), the findings list and the gate statement.

Findings: the R4 status guard in startRun is not reachable by a real press (gap). The R8 disabled-click guard protects the AI-off next step, which this suite does not mount. The R11 destroy guards are equivalent when removed one at a time. The task-surface setup (runnable offer plus filledRung pr) matches the production gates.

Full unit suite, branch vs main: 23,589 tests each, 0 failures on either side, identical passing names.

Autopilot (stepper) run summary, LIN-4266 implementation arc. Five beats in one warm worker session (ROOT 9a152c05-7694-4092-bb87-97560aea7cc2):
1/5 ground + baseline: 30/30 before-run, assertion map R1-R12. Accepted.
2/5 port onto loadWorld: 30/30, names unchanged, partial mutation table. Challenged: only 5 rows mutated.
3/5 complete mutation proof: every row red except three reported gaps (R4 startRun status guard unreachable by a real press; R8 disabled guard protects the AI-off next step this suite doesn't mount; R11 equivalent destroy guards, red only combined). Setup change (runnable offer + filledRung 'pr') justified from source. Name diff empty.
4/5 census: removed from HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES, fake-dom.js consumer list updated; census 43/43; full unit suite 23,589/0 on branch and main with identical passing names.
5/5 PR: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2299 (head eec8eb12, not merged).
Verified by me: PR OPEN/MERGEABLE, all 7 checks SUCCESS on eec8eb12 via gh (Unit tests, E2E 1-4/4, Secret scan, CI success). No `value is not modelled on <select>` artefact hit. LIN-4255 comment posted (fit in one session; recommends continuing the family).
Left: independent review, then close-out (merge + Done).

## Review — LIN-4266

Reviewed PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2299 at head `eec8eb12` (base `6ff38cf5`). Current `main` is `6d287518` (LIN-4270, which touches `tests/unit/helpers/fake-dom.js`). I also checked the head merged with that main: local merge `ff2c4aa7`, which merges cleanly.

CI: green on `eec8eb12` (run 42039197932: Unit tests, E2E 1/4 to 4/4, Secret scan, CI success). CI did not run on head merged with current main. I ran the unit suite on that merge myself: `npm run test:unit`, 23,596 tests, 0 failures.

### Scope against the ticket
- Diff is 3 files: `prompt-section-go.test.js`, `fake-dom-census.test.js` (one entry removed) and the `fake-dom.js` header. The suite's own `makeContainer`, `replaceSlot`/`replaceGoSlot` and `vm.createContext` sandbox are gone. It now uses `loadWorld({ window, scripts, timers, globals })` and `world.makeContainer()`. Nothing outside the plan's files changed, and the source is untouched.
- The header **joins** the consumer list instead of being removed from it. That matches the move-rule correction accepted on LIN-4255 (comment 13:25Z), so it is not an overrun.
- Test names: I ran `node --test --test-reporter=spec` on base, head and head merged with main and stripped timings. All three name lists are identical: 30 tests, 3 suites, same order. Head and merge both pass 30 of 30. With `fake-dom-census` and `fake-dom.test.js` added, the merge passes 124 of 124.
- The PR has the assertion map, findings list and gate statement. The LIN-4255 gate comment is posted (13:56Z). There are no prior rulings on LIN-4266.

### Regression check
In the last 30 commits on these files there are no reverts. LIN-4247 (`b5cc4c62`) added the stale poll-read guard, and its test is kept. The Stop test now makes two real presses and still goes red when that guard is removed (PR row "Bonus"). The behaviour from LIN-4246 and LIN-4252 is untouched.

### Mutation check (re-run independently on the merged tree, source restored after each one)
| Mutation in `public/prompt-section.js` | Result |
|---|---|
| `paintGo` always does a full `render()` | RED (3): N4 body node, repaint test, panel test |
| `paintGo` writes the slot and then also does `container.innerHTML = container.innerHTML` (the ticket's own example) | RED (3), same tests |
| `refreshRunQuota` with `!initial` calls `render()` instead of `paintGo`+`paintLadder` | RED: repaint test |
| `paintLadder` always does a full render | RED: repaint test |
| `panelNow = null` in `startRun` (R10) | RED: non-blank harness test |
| `stop-run` no longer opens the confirm (R6) | RED: the LIN-4247 Stop test (`no button stop-run-confirm is drawn`) |
| `startRun` status guard removed (R4-GAP) | GREEN, as the PR reports |

**R4-GAP checked.** I probed the drawn controls while a press is held in `starting`: Swipe default, `freeTier`, and the task surface with an offer and `filledRung` set to `pr`, `done` or unset. In every case no enabled `go` **or** `go-done` button is left. `startRun` is called only from those two actions. So within the modelled DOM, the guard really cannot be reached by a press. The old test reached it only through the fake's click shim, which built a button from the dataset alone without checking the markup. That coverage was never real, so nothing true was lost.

**Setup claim (minor, wording only).** Only the runnable **offer** is load-bearing. Replacing it with `NOT_YET` turns the Stop test red: `no button {"action":"go","rung":"run-task"}`. `filledRung: 'pr'` is not load-bearing: with it removed, all 30 still pass. With an offer and no `filledRung`, `go|run-task` is still drawn, as a quiet rung rather than as `opened-task-go`. The test comment is accurate. The PR body's "only when both gates hold" is not.

### Isolated, or one of a class?
This is one instance of a class: hand-written fake DOMs and `vm` sandboxes in client suites, listed in `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` (55 left). Each remaining member is already owned by a sibling move ticket under LIN-4255: LIN-4267, LIN-4268, LIN-4269 and LIN-4271. They are outside this ticket's bounded class, which is the single suite `prompt-section-go.test.js`. No ledger item.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Inside: the head is behind current main.** CI ran on `eec8eb12`, based on `6ff38cf5`. Main is now `6d287518`, and LIN-4270 changes `fake-dom.js` (className/id reflection), which this suite now runs on. **Before the merge:** my local merge `ff2c4aa7` passes the full unit suite (23,596 tests, 0 failures) and the 30 names are unchanged. Close-out should update the branch, or merge with an up-to-date check, and confirm CI is green on the exact merge commit. The distinguishing condition is that `prompt-section-go.test.js` stays 30 of 30 with the LIN-4270 fake. My local run is a substitute with known limits: it is not a clean environment and covers no commits after `6d287518`.
- **Outside: the R8 `btn.disabled` guard in `handleClick` (AI-off ✦ next step) is not witnessed by this file.** This suite never mounts AI-off. That is a different surface, not this ticket's. **Settle:** close-out greps for an existing AI-off disabled-next-step press test (for example `data-prompt="__ai__"` with `disabled`). It files a follow-up only if none exists.
- **Outside: the prompt-section family gate.** The ticket says the family stops after this suite and the follow-on prompt-section subtasks (LIN-4267, LIN-4268) are re-planned. The PR's gate statement instead recommends continuing with a pre-port probe. That decision belongs to the parent, LIN-4255, not to this merge. **Settle:** close-out makes sure LIN-4267 and LIN-4268 are not dispatched as written until LIN-4255 has re-planned them or explicitly accepted the "continue" recommendation.

Fix for close-out (PR description only, no code): in the **Task-surface setup change** finding, change "Production draws a pressable run-task Go on the task page only when both gates hold" to "Production draws the run-task Go only with an offer. `filledRung: 'pr'` makes it the primary `opened-task-go` (without it, Go is still drawn as a quiet rung and Next step is primary). Only the offer is load-bearing for the Stop test."

### Verdict
Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger.
The move is complete and faithful: names and count are unchanged, both local copies are gone, the census is ratcheted, and every assertion-map row goes red under its mutation except the two documented, verified-unreachable guards. What is left is the merge on current main and two items that belong to the parent.

## Close-out — LIN-4266

**Merged:** https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2299, squash commit `56f9b474` on main, pinned with `--match-head-commit e35dfaf6`. The change is test-only (`prompt-section-go.test.js`, the census entry, the `fake-dom.js` header), so there is no deploy to wait for. I checked it on main: `prompt-section-go` and `fake-dom-census` pass 73 of 73, with the go suite at 30 of 30.

**CI:** Review's Approve was conditional on the branch being current. The head `eec8eb12` was behind main (LIN-4270 changed `fake-dom.js`). I updated the branch with `gh pr update-branch`, which gave head `e35dfaf6`. CI was green on that exact commit: Unit tests, E2E shards 1/4 to 4/4, Secret scan, CI success. Merged on a fresh read of that rollup.

**Changes I made after approval** (none touch code):
- `e35dfaf6`: the update-branch merge of main (`6d287518`) into the PR branch. No conflicts. It answers the review line "head is behind current main".
- PR description edit (no commit): rewrote the **Task-surface setup change** finding so that only the runnable offer is load-bearing, and `filledRung: 'pr'` only makes Go the primary `opened-task-go`. It answers the review's "Fix for close-out".

**Ledger:**
- *Inside, head behind main.* Done. `prompt-section-go.test.js` runs 30 of 30 with the LIN-4270 fake. I ran it on `e35dfaf6` and again on merged main, and CI is green on `e35dfaf6`.
- *Outside, R8 `btn.disabled` guard (AI-off next step).* An existing test already witnesses it: `tests/unit/prompt-section-p0.test.js:1051` presses a disabled `__ai__` button and asserts no fetch. It is a synthetic-button press, so LIN-4267 (which owns `-p0`) should keep it witnessed through the real DOM. No new ticket filed. I linked the finding on LIN-4267.
- *Outside, family gate.* The parent LIN-4255 decides this. LIN-4267 and LIN-4268 are still Todo and must not be dispatched as written until LIN-4255 has re-planned them or accepted the "continue" recommendation. I commented on both. I raised no ruling, because LIN-4255 already holds the decision (the gate comment of 13:56Z).
- *Known gaps the PR reports:* R4 (`startRun` status guard, unreachable by a real press), R8 (see above), R11 (equivalent destroy guards). Review verified R4 independently. None of them is a regression, since the old coverage was fake-only.

**Not proven:** CI is not a clean-room run. It covers nothing merged after `6d287518`. No named monitor applies to a test-only change.

**Follow-ups filed:** none. No new outside items beyond those above.

**Description:** archived (snapshot confirmed, 3 snapshots). Nothing pruned. The description holds only the original brief, the rules and the pointer to the parent plan, with no embedded plan or research sections to discharge.
